title: Measuring and Mitigating Biases in Motor Insurance Pricing
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus is on gender bias in motor insurance pricing.
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion. The study focuses on identifying and mitigating gender bias in the context of motor insurance pricing.
